weeks.title: 5 things the UK is buying right now

heated-throw.name: Heated throw, 160 x 130cm
heated-throw.blurb: The Amazon best seller. Ten heat settings, nine-hour timer, machine washable. A heated throw draws roughly 120 to 160 watts, so an evening on the sofa costs a few pence rather than putting the heating on.

lumie-sunrise-alarm.name: Lumie Sunrise Alarm
lumie-sunrise-alarm.blurb: The clocks go back on 25 October. A sunrise alarm brightens gradually for half an hour before the alarm, so you wake up in fake daylight instead of the dark. Lumie is the British brand that started the category.

karcher-wv1.name: Kärcher WV 1 window vac
karcher-wv1.blurb: Condensation season. Run it over the inside of the window in the morning and the water goes into the tank instead of down the wall and into the sealant. 20 minutes per charge, which does a whole house.

medicube-pdrn-balm.name: Medicube PDRN Collagen Volume Multi Balm Stick
medicube-pdrn-balm.blurb: The most-bought skincare product on Amazon UK right now. A balm stick for under-eyes, smile lines, neck and lips. Korean brand, went viral on TikTok in the summer and hasn't slowed down.

shark-flexstyle.name: Shark FlexStyle 5-in-1 Air Styler and Hair Dryer
shark-flexstyle.blurb: The Dyson Airwrap alternative. Dries, curls with auto-wrap barrels, and has the oval brush and concentrator. Was £269.99 to £299.99 depending on the kit, and down to £229.99 at both Amazon and Argos.
